claim.why_it_matters: Printed as a numbered subsection heading (sibling of 1.3.1/1.3.2, which page 689 renders as '####'); the markdown leaves it as a plain paragraph.

verdict.reasoning: The printed page XV-2 (PDF p690) sets '1.3.3 Compile Time Switch' on its own line as a numbered subsection heading, in the same style as '1.3.4 Object Time Switch' below it. In page-690.md both are plain paragraph lines. Page 689's markdown marks the siblings '#### 1.3.1 Debug Features' and '#### 1.3.2 Special Register DEBUG-ITEM' under '### 1.3 LANGUAGE CONCEPTS'. The heading text is word for word the same in both sources, so only the heading markup is missing. That is a structural defect in the section hierarchy, and the wording, rules and semantics are unaffected.
verdict.corrected_description: The heading text is identical. Only the '####' heading markup is missing for '1.3.3 Compile Time Switch' on p690. '1.3.4 Object Time Switch' on the same page lacks the markup in the same way.
